verdict.rationale: Maritime documents one bulk capability of its own: importing many configuration variables at once from a .env file or stdin, followed by a hot-reload. That covers only one narrow item type (env vars on an agent). Nothing shows bulk actions across many agents, computers or other resources. Migration via an external agent recreating each workload is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. Missing for 10: bulk operations across multiple agents/resources (e.g. batch deploy, delete, update or restart), bulk API/CLI endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Bulk import from a .env file (or stdin), then hot-reload
